description: SU(2) BMN-sector Q-cohomology on SU(3)_R highest-weight vectors: all 446 dominant columns lam = (q1>=q2>=q3) with j = 2(q1+q2+q3) <= 44, every nonempty 2J (3182 sectors). Per column: j, lam, rep = [q1-q2, q2-q3], euler (sum over 2J of (-1)^2J h), index (multiplicity of the irrep in the exact BMN index), all_checks. Per sector: twoJ, E = j/2 - J, m (exact hw multiplicity), h (multiplicity of the irrep in cohomology), grav (multi-graviton part: products of u_n, v_n, w_n, n <= 2, modulo Q-exact, full 2x2 matrices), BH = h - grav (non-graviton classes), check. Result: 186 multiplets, 166 multi-graviton and 20 non-graviton in 17 sectors at j = 24..44 (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 3, 2, 2, 3, 3 per level); all non-graviton classes have an odd number of letters.
code: fortuity.hwcoh.run_sectors (MAXLEN = MAXLEN_UP = 3, GEN_NMAX = 2, SEED = 1; ENGINE=par for the large sectors), assembled with fortuity.hwcoh.to_json
command: per-sector records: scripts/bmn/su2-level44-scan (setup.sbatch, su2_scan.sbatch, su2_col.sbatch, tasks_su2_j44.txt); assembly: PYTHONPATH=code python3 -m fortuity.hwcoh.to_json 'data/su2/hw_cohomology_j44_records/*.jsonl' 2 OUT.json
checked: per-sector exact-dimension self-check (rank of the hw vectors at the functionals = exact multiplicity, per fermion degree; this also certifies that traces of length <= 3 span) in all 3182 sectors; Euler characteristic = exact index in all 446 columns; reproduces the direct cohomology of R-001 (data/su2/bmn_direct_cohomology_j28.json): the cohomology and graviton dimensions of all 683 weight sectors with j <= 28, obtained from the irrep multiplicities with SU(3) weight multiplicities, agree exactly (checked 2026-10-14); the number of non-graviton classes equals -T (data/su2/kernel_parity_j44.json) in every column; the non-graviton counts of all 17 sectors were reproduced by the full-letter one-loop runs (scripts/oneloop/su-threshold-classes/runs/t040_oneloop_table.json); re-assembled from the records on 2026-10-14 with identical content.
caveat: classical Q (tree level); 'graviton' in the sense of section 2.2 of the summary; ranks over F_p, p = 2^26 - 5
